name: CommandBarControl
description: Represents a command bar control. The CommandBarControl object is a member of the CommandBarControls collection. The properties and methods of the CommandBarControl object are all shared by the CommandBarButton, CommandBarComboBox, and CommandBarPopup objects.
remarks: When writing Visual Basic code to work with custom command bar controls, you use the CommandBarButton, CommandBarComboBox, and CommandBarPopup objects. When writing code to work with built-in controls in the container application that cannot be represented by one of those three objects, you use the CommandBarControl object. Use Controls (_index_), where _index_ is the index number of a control, to return a CommandBarControl object. (The Type property of the control must be msoControlLabel, msoControlExpandingGrid, msoControlSplitExpandingGrid, msoControlGrid, or msoControlGauge). Variables declared as CommandBarControl can be assigned CommandBarButton, CommandBarComboBox, and CommandBarPopup values.
example:
Set lbl = CommandBars.FindControl(Type:= msoControlGauge)
If lbl Is Nothing Then
    MsgBox "A control of type msoControlGauge was not found."
Else
    MsgBox "Control " & lbl.Index & " on command bar " _
        & lbl.Parent.Name & " is type msoControlGauge"
End If

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CommandBarControl object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CommandBarControl object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: BeginGroup
properties.description: Gets True if the specified command bar control appears at the beginning of a group of controls on the command bar. Read/write.

properties.name: BuiltIn
properties.description: Gets True if the specified command bar control is a built-in control of the container application. Returns False if it's a custom control, or if it's a built-in control whose OnAction property has been set. Read-only.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Gets or sets the caption text for a command bar control. Read/write.

properties.name: DescriptionText
properties.description: Gets or sets the description for a command bar control. Read/write.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: Gets or sets a Boolean value specifying if the CommandBarControl is enabled. Read/write.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Gets or sets the height of a CommandBarControl control. Read/write.

properties.name: HelpContextId
properties.description: Gets or sets the Help context Id number for the Help topic attached to the CommandBarControl. Read/write.

properties.name: HelpFile
properties.description: Gets or sets the file name for the Help topic attached to the CommandBarControl. Read/write.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Gets the ID for a built-in CommandBarControl. Read-only.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Gets a Long representing the index number for a CommandBarControl object in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Gets the horizontal position of the specified CommandBarControl (in pixels) relative to the left edge of the screen. Returns the distance from the left side of the docking area. Read-only.

properties.name: OLEUsage
properties.description: Gets or sets the OLE client and OLE server roles in which a CommandBarControl will be used when two Microsoft Office applications are merged. Read/write.

properties.name: OnAction
properties.description: Gets or sets the name of a Visual Basic procedure that will run when the user clicks or changes the value of a CommandBarControl. Read/write.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CommandBarControl object. Read-only.

properties.name: Parameter
properties.description: Gets or sets a string that an application can use to execute a command from a CommandBarControl. Read/write.

properties.name: Priority
properties.description: Gets or sets the priority of a CommandBarControl. A control's priority determines whether the control can be dropped from a docked command bar if the command bar controls can't fit in a single row. Controls that can't fit in a single row drop off command bars from right to left. Read/write.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: Gets or sets information about the CommandBarControl, such as data that can be used as an argument in procedures, or information that identifies the control. Read/write.

properties.name: TooltipText
properties.description: Gets or sets the text displayed in the ScreenTip of a CommandBarControl. Read/write.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Gets the distance (in pixels) from the top edge of the specified CommandBarControl to the top edge of the screen. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets the type of CommandBarControl. Read-only.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Gets or sets the Visible property of the CommandBarControl. True if the CommandBarControl is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Gets or sets the width (in pixels) of the specified CommandBarControl. Read/write.

properties.name: IsPriorityDropped
properties.description: Gets True if the control is currently dropped from the menu or toolbar based on usage statistics and layout space. (Note that this is not the same as the control's visibility, as set by the Visible property). Read-only.

methods.name: Copy
methods.signature: Copy([Bar As Variant], [Before As Variant]) As CommandBarControl
methods.description: Copies a command bar control to an existing command bar.

parameters.name: Bar
parameters.description: A CommandBar object that represents the destination command bar. If this argument is omitted, the control is copied to the command bar where the control already exists.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: A number that indicates the position for the new control on the command bar. The new control will be inserted before the control at this position. If this argument is omitted, the control is copied to the end of the command bar.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the CommandBarControl object from its collection.

parameters.name: Temporary
parameters.description: True to delete the control for the current session. The application will display the control again in the next session.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Runs the procedure or built-in command assigned to the specified CommandBarControl control.

methods.name: Move
methods.signature: Move([Bar As Variant], [Before As Variant]) As CommandBarControl
methods.description: Moves the specified CommandBarControl to an existing command bar.

parameters.name: Bar
parameters.description: A Command object that represents the destination command bar for the control. If this argument is omitted, the control is moved to the end of the command bar where the control currently resides.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: A number that indicates the position for the control. The control is inserted before the control currently occupying this position. If this argument is omitted, the control is inserted on the same command bar.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets a built-in command bar to its default configuration, or resets a built-in CommandBarControl to its original function and face.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: Moves the keyboard focus to the specified CommandBarControl. If the control is disabled or isn't visible, this method will fail.
